# Lon 2026-10-23, verbatim: "How can a program that can not be measured be a FAILURE?", ceo CEO-1926): every shipped program this package has no
# ref for -- its 253 UNGRADABLE.tsv rows (the 10-14 conversion skipped xsb_tests, which had no suite row then) and its 402 UNGRADED.tsv rows --
# measured again by the coo on 2026-10-23, one program at a time, staged as util_build_package_suite.py stages it (a fresh cwd holding every
# non-ALL file of the package, the source written last, swipl -q, stdin /dev/null), twice: 651 print nothing on both runs and 4 run past 120 s on
# both, so the oracle gives none of them an answer. Each row carries its list's class and evidence and today's reading. An UNGRADED row STAYS in
# UNGRADED.tsv: NEEDS_DRIVER (257), NEEDS_RUNNER_WIRING (141) and TIMEOUT (4) are work owed on OUR side (a driver, a staging map for a sibling
# loaded by its upstream name -- 17 of the 141 name a sibling this package vendors -- or a longer declared time), and the program returns to the
# denominator in the landing that gives it its answer.
